patch_description: The current program's key parameters are: 9 hex-row seeds, single SLSQP pass (maxiter=250, ftol=1e-12), a crude `_repair` that shrinks radii (losing radius mass), and no restarts. Key changes: (1) replace the shrinking repair with exact Gauss-Seidel `grow_radii` which maximally grows every radius given the centers, guaranteeing feasibility with no lost radius; (2) add 3–5 SLSQP restart ("polish") passes, feeding each repaired endpoint back as the new start with maxiter=500, ftol=1e-14, stopping when improvement < 1e-6; (3) supply analytic constraint Jacobians so SLSQP converges much further per iteration; (4) seed feasible radii from exact growth shrunk 2%, so SLSQP starts from a near-optimal point. Restarts from feasible near-optimal endpoints let SLSQP make fine tangency adjustments unreachable in one pass — the direct route toward closing the gap to 2.635.
